newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ASENAL APPEAL AGAINST ADAMS'S ONE-MATCH BAN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ASENAL APPEAL AGAINST ADAMS'S ONE-MATCH BAN.

text.p: English premier league leaders Arsenal said on Tuesday they had appealed against Tony Adams's automatic one-match ban incurred after he was sent off against Newcastle.
The London club have sent a video of Saturday's incident to the Football Association and asked referee Graham Barber to review his decision. Only the match referee can over-rule the suspension.
Adams will be suspended for Arsenal's December 21 trip to Nottingham Forest unless Barber changes his mind.

Barber ruled that Adams's challenge from behind deliberately denied Alan Shearer a goalscoring opportunity but Arsenal contend that Newcastle striker Faustino Asprilla was in an offside position at the time of the offence.
